intent: An ancient Grashan court gown in pale ruin stone with old-bronze trim and a moss petticoat, reading from the high camera as a narrow crowned top drawn to a bronze belt over one continuous, back-closed pale tasset bell that runs unbroken from waist to hem.
requests: A verdigris patina colour between bronze and moss so the plates can carry the 'old green-bronze' read without relying on a second green.
A skirt piece that flares in two axes at once; flat boxes can only build the bell from overlapping plates.
A knee-bending skirt segment; the thigh and shin tiers can only be overlapped, not articulated.
